preRegistration: Fixed before any result was seen: 6 rolling origins (end of Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug 2026); horizons 1–3 months; 4 methods (rolling-6, rolling-12 = today's method, seasonal naive, damped Holt-Winters ETS); metrics WAPE and bias on PO units per country × product; headline = Products A + B on de-duplicated customers (golden IDs), each cell's units valued at its average S$ price so a reagent kit and a box of pipette tips count by value; Product C reported separately. At each origin every method is refit on data up to and including the origin month only, then scored on the next 1–3 months that exist (to Sep 2026): 15 scored points per cell (the Jul-2026 origin contributes h=1–2, Aug-2026 h=1). Leak test: overwriting every month after the origin with garbage leaves every forecast unchanged.

methods.label: Rolling 6-month average
methods.description: Mean of the last 6 months of PO units, held flat for the next 1–3 months.

methods.label: Rolling 12-month average (today's method)
methods.description: Mean of the last 12 months of PO units, held flat. This is the current method described in the brief.

methods.label: Seasonal naive
methods.description: Same month last year (PO units 12 months before the forecast month).

methods.label: Damped Holt-Winters ETS (ours)
methods.description: statsmodels ExponentialSmoothing: additive damped trend + additive seasonality, period 12, parameters and initial states estimated by maximum likelihood; refit at every origin; forecasts floored at 0.

headline.scope: Products A + B, all 5 countries, de-duplicated customers (golden IDs); cells weighted by S$ value
headline.plainBaseline: Today's method is off by 11 units per 100 ordered
headline.plainOurs: Ours is off by 9 units per 100 ordered
headline.plainBiasBaseline: Today's method tends to under-forecast by 10%

winLoss.sentence: Ours beats today's method in 7 of 10 country × product cells (A: 4 of 5, B: 3 of 5); today's method wins 3 (MY·A, TH·B, MM·B). Losses are shown, not hidden.

productC.note: Product C (instruments) is lumpy and tender-driven: today's method is off by 31 units per 100 ordered, ours off by 35 units per 100 ordered; neither is good enough to plan with. C is planned from the tender/PR pipeline, not from a time-series forecast, and is excluded from the headline.

intervalMethod: Oct–Dec 2026: damped ETS refit on all 36 months. P10/P90 = ETS point forecast × the 10th/90th percentile of actual ÷ forecast ratios from this backtest, pooled across the 5 countries within each product and horizon (empirical, from backtest residuals; no normality assumption). P50 = the ETS point forecast.
